claim: A shootable object can open a secret: Blood hangs a fire extinguisher (kThingObjectGib) on a wall; when it dies the engine turns it OFF, and with trigger_off set that Off edge sends the thing's own command on its channel -- kCmdOn (1) in both precedents -- so a shut Z-motion sector in the wall behind it opens in a tenth of a second while exploders on the same channel go off staggered.
evidence: E3M4 sprite 331 (type 416, tx 156, command 1, trigger_on and trigger_off) opens E3M4 s320 (type 600, rx 156, busy_time_a 1); E3M4 sprites 332-334 (type 459, rx 156, wait 1, 4, 3) the staggered charges
E1M2 sprite 489 (tx 114, command 1) opens E1M2 s240 and s241 (type 600) with exploders 490-492; that hole is a counted secret

NBlood/source/blood/src/actor.cpp:3513 trTriggerSprite(..., kCmdOff, ...) when a thing is destroyed; actor.cpp:2551 actInit starts every such thing at state 1, so the Off is an edge; triggers.cpp:626-634 OperateSprite turns it Off and gibs it; triggers.cpp:104-105 SetSpriteState sends pXSprite->command on the Off edge when triggerOff is set
use: Give the object a tx, trigger_off and the command the receivers need (On to open a shut sector); wire the hidden sector and the charges to it. Lay the hole ragged with bloodmap.breach.ragged.
